{{Wireless adapter |brand=Accton |model=WN3501AR |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=10/03/2001 |manuf_country=Taiwan |is_manuf=True |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=USB |if_bus_version=1.1 |if_connector_type=Female B |form_factor=corded (modular) adapter |vendor_id= |device_id= |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string= |fcc_id=HED0109WN3501AR |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Atmel |chip1_model=AT76C503A |chip2_brand=RFMD |chip2_model= |chip3_brand= |chip3_model= |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn= |802dot11_protocols=b |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui= |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} "AR503AB-2" and "Rev: T1.0" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
There is a sticker with a MAC address affixed to the board in the FCC photos. The MAC address is '''0090D1006C4B''' ('''Leichu''' OUI, used mainly by Eumitcom manuf. gear). It is presumed this device was designed when Eumitcom was still independent.
